newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska sells 51 pct of Holmsund, Leksell.
newsitem.headline: Skanska sells 51 pct of Holmsund, Leksell.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska AB said on Friday it reached agreement to sell 51 percent of shares in Holmsund Golv AB and its subsidiary Leksells Golv AB to U.S.'s Armstrong Industries Inc..
Holmsund and Leksells, which produce and market resilient flooring products, have combined annual sales of about $30 million, Skanska said in a statement.
The joint venture deal strengthens a 1994 cooperation agreement between Skanska and resilient flooring maker Armstrong, the company said.
"This is the next logical step in our cooperation and an industrially proper solution for Holmsund/Leksells," company spokesman Anders Karlsson said.
